prediction.sql:
WITH EnrollmentRanked AS (
  SELECT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."School Name" AS "School Name",
    f."District Name" AS "District Name",
    f."County Name" AS "County Name",
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS TotalEnrollment,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" AS FreeMealCount,
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS CharterFlag,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC) AS EnrollmentRank
  FROM frpm AS f
)
SELECT
  er.EnrollmentRank AS EnrollmentRank,
  er."School Name" AS "School Name",
  er."District Name" AS "District Name",
  er."County Name" AS "County Name",
  er.TotalEnrollment AS TotalEnrollment,
  er.FreeMealCount AS FreeMealCount,
  ROUND(er.FreeMealCount * 1.0 / er.TotalEnrollment * 100, 2) || '%' AS EligibleFreeRate,
  s.City AS City,
  CASE WHEN er.CharterFlag = 1 THEN 'Charter School' ELSE 'Regular School' END AS SchoolType,
  s.GSoffered AS GradeSpan,
  s.Website AS Website,
  ss.NumTstTakr AS SATTestTakers,
  ss.AvgScrRead AS AvgReadingScore,
  ss.AvgScrMath AS AvgMathScore,
  ss.AvgScrWrite AS AvgWritingScore,
  COALESCE(ROUND(ss.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / ss.NumTstTakr * 100, 2), 0) || '%' AS PercentAbove1500SAT
FROM EnrollmentRanked AS er
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = er.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = er.CDSCode AND ss.rtype = 'S'
WHERE er.EnrollmentRank IN (10, 11)
ORDER BY er.EnrollmentRank;
